description: Google Maps patch for ReVanced GmsCore, enabled by default for Morphe Desktop Quick mode. Renames app-owned custom permission declarations and matching manifest references to the patched Maps namespace, preventing duplicate-permission installation conflicts with original Google Maps. Suppresses the misleading Google Play services update notification raised when an optional API requests a feature unavailable from ReVanced GmsCore, without reporting the missing feature as supported. Preserves the existing package, provider, Timeline semantic location, MicroG account access, Phenotype service, Google Intent action routing, and original Picture-in-Picture declaration. Supports Google Maps 26.32.06.958047303, stable target 26.30.09.950492155, and earlier compatible targets 26.29.02.946673643, 26.28.03.942936911, 26.27.05.941319029, and 26.26.04.935742811.
